notes.title: We are part of Steam Autumn Sale 2022!
notes.content:
Just in case if you haven't had the opportunity to try [i]Ferrule Instincts[/i] yet, it's now [b]40% off[/b]!

Yes, we are part of the Steam Autumn Sale that runs through November 29, and we are offering everyone a pretty nice discount. Fact of the matter is, lots of people we know are busy buying turkeys and racking their brains for dinner table debate topics, so we thought it'll be a good idea to help out all we can.

In the wallet department.

But seriously, if you still haven't gotten into the action of holding Kayla's fate in your hands, now is the perfect time! Check with your own Steam Store for the final price -- we hear the deal is even better in your country!

Happy Thanksgiving, and for everyone else, a very happy holiday season!

notes.title: Ferrule Instincts is here!
notes.content:
Over two years in the making, we are pleased to say that our debut visual novel, [i]Ferrule Instincts[/I], is here!

The result of working with indie artist Nenetlitzi, this title is all about using your instincts to navigate Kayla through dangers to get to her birthday safe and sound.

Yellow Optic and Nenetlitzi worked around the clock to deliver incredible high-quality art, a fun story, and a complete reimagining of the original novel [i]Fool Me Twice[/i] into this new medium.

A portion of every single purchase of Ferrule Instincts will go towards supporting the artist!

Of course, Kayla wants to celebrate her birthday with everyone, so she's giving everyone a discount! It's available now for just $3.99 until August 19.

Enjoy, and let us know what you think!
